aliases: Google Kansas City, Missouri data center
status_as_of_cutoff: Port KC authorized up to $10 billion in Project Mica taxable revenue bonds on 2025-07-28 by unanimous vote. Google and trade reporting later identified active development/construction, and Google's current location material lists Kansas City, Missouri in development. No building-level permit, inspection, CO, utility interconnection, energization, commissioning, or live-service record was located. Bond authorization is not treated as construction approval.
